Description: This field is used to calculate the frequency of the SDCLK pin. The definition of this field is dependent on the Host Controller Version. (1) 8-bit Divided Clock Mode - This mode is supported by the Host Controller version 1.00 and version 2.00. The frequency is not programmed directly; rather the register holds the divisor of the Base Clock Frequency For SD Clock in the Capabilities register. Only the following settings are allowed. [8h]: base clock divided by 256 [4h]: base clock divided by 128 [2h]: base clock divided by 64 [1h]: base clock divided by 32 [80h]: base clock divided by 16 [40h]: base clock divided by 8 [20h]: base clock divided by 4 [10h]: base clock divided by 2 [00h]: base clock (10MHz-63MHz) Setting 0 (Dh) specifies the highest frequency of the SD Clock. When setting this field, the HC shall also set the divided but it should not be set. The three default divisor values can be calculated by the frequency that is defined by the Base Clock Frequency For SD Clock in the Capabilities register. 25MHz divider value = (Base Clock) / 25MHz 50MHz divider value = (Base Clock) / 50MHz According to the SD Host Controller Standard Layer Specification, the maximum SD Clock frequency is 25 MHz in normal speed mode and 50MHz in high speed mode, and shall never exceed this limit. The actual frequency of SDCLK is set by the following formula: Clock Frequency = (Base Clock) / divisor
